title: A draft's preview prints 'deferred to confirm' on a close a cited green run would clear, not BLOCKED
why: Record (coordinator 00:08 CST Nov 15, relaying lane debt-close-reads-ci's round 1 note on PR #3452, head 446866008e21; the lane's report, not read by triage): lint/check_debt_retire.py:242-245, judge_close runs the deferred branch before the cite is read, so a draft's preview prints BLOCKED on a delete that a cited green run would clear when the PR is ready. Preview-only, merge unaffected. The lane's preferred fix is to print 'deferred to confirm' as a note instead of BLOCKED. It needs a code change and a fresh review round, so it is a later step after #3452 merges. A note, not a debt: no incident yet. Kin: step debt-close-reads-ci.
